checks.label: Secure connection (HTTPS)
checks.detail: The page loads over HTTPS (https://example.com/).
checks.fix: No action needed.

checks.label: Page title shown in Google results
checks.detail: Title is 14 characters (aim for 30 to 60): "Example Domain".
checks.fix: Lengthen the title to 30 to 60 characters: business name, main service, city.

checks.label: Description snippet shown under the title in Google
checks.detail: No meta description found.
checks.fix: Write a 70 to 160 character description that says what you offer, where, and why to choose you.

checks.label: One clear main heading on the page
checks.detail: No H1 heading found.
checks.fix: Add one H1 heading that says what you do and where, for example 'Emergency Plumber in Austin'.

checks.label: Preferred address of the page (canonical tag)
checks.detail: No canonical tag found.
checks.fix: Add a <link rel="canonical"> tag that points to the preferred address of this page.

checks.label: Page allows search engines to list it
checks.detail: No noindex directive found.
checks.fix: No action needed.

checks.label: Images have text descriptions (alt text)
checks.detail: No images found on the page, so there is nothing to score.
checks.fix: Nothing to fix here.

checks.label: Enough written content on the page
checks.detail: About 27 words of visible text (aim for 300 or more).
checks.fix: Expand the page to at least 300 words covering what you do, for whom, where, prices and common questions.

checks.label: Preview title and image when shared on social media
checks.detail: No og:title or og:image tags found.
checks.fix: Add og:title and og:image tags so links shared on Facebook, LinkedIn or WhatsApp show a proper preview.

checks.label: Instructions file for search engine robots (robots.txt)
checks.detail: No robots.txt (HTTP 404). Not harmful by itself, since search engines then crawl everything, but it is the usual place to point them to your sitemap.
checks.fix: Add a simple robots.txt that allows crawling and lists your sitemap address.

checks.label: List of pages for search engines (sitemap.xml)
checks.detail: No sitemap at /sitemap.xml (HTTP 404) and none listed in robots.txt.
checks.fix: Generate a sitemap.xml (most site builders and SEO plugins do this) and list it in robots.txt.

checks.label: Page is set up for mobile phones
checks.detail: Viewport tag found: 'width=device-width,initial-scale=1'. (Basic signal only, not a full mobile test.)
checks.fix: No action needed.

checks.label: Page code is a reasonable size
checks.detail: The HTML itself is 1 KB (images, scripts and styles loaded separately are not counted).
checks.fix: No action needed.

checks.label: Server answers quickly
checks.detail: The page took 0.42 s to download from the audit machine (one measurement, includes redirects; not a full speed test).
checks.fix: No action needed.

checks.label: Phone number customers can tap to call
checks.detail: No phone number found on the page.
checks.fix: Show your phone number near the top of the page as a tap-to-call link.

checks.label: Business address search engines can read
checks.detail: No business address found in the page text or structured data.
checks.fix: Show your address or service area on the page and add it to LocalBusiness schema.

checks.label: Link or map to find you on Google Maps
checks.detail: No Google Maps embed or link found. This is a bonus item, so it only counts as 'needs work'.
checks.fix: Embed your Google Maps location or link to your Google Business Profile.

checks.label: Structured data for search engines and AI (JSON-LD)
checks.detail: No JSON-LD structured data found.
checks.fix: Add JSON-LD structured data (Organization or LocalBusiness at minimum) so search engines and AI tools can read your key facts reliably.

checks.label: Types of structured data found
checks.detail: No schema.org types found (checked JSON-LD and microdata).
checks.fix: Describe the business with schema.org types such as LocalBusiness, Service and FAQPage.

checks.label: FAQ marked up so AI tools can quote answers
checks.detail: No FAQPage or QAPage schema found. Google shows FAQ rich results only for a small set of sites since 2023, but a marked-up question and answer block is still a clean, structured source for answer engines.
checks.fix: Add an FAQ section with 3 to 8 real customer questions and mark it up with FAQPage schema.

checks.label: Headings phrased as customer questions
checks.detail: No H2/H3 headings end with a question mark.
checks.fix: Rewrite some subheadings as the questions customers ask, for example 'How much does a drain cleaning cost?', and answer each one right below.

checks.label: Business identity for AI tools (name and social profiles)
checks.detail: No Organization or LocalBusiness schema found in JSON-LD.
checks.fix: Add Organization or LocalBusiness schema with your exact business name and sameAs links to your Google Business Profile, Facebook, LinkedIn and Yelp pages.

checks.label: Guide file for AI assistants (llms.txt)
checks.detail: No llms.txt found (HTTP 404). llms.txt is an emerging, voluntary convention proposed in 2024; no major search engine has confirmed using it, so it is only scored as 'needs work' when missing.
checks.fix: Optionally add /llms.txt with a short plain-text summary of the business and links to key pages.
